description: Old Starfleet secrets, Cardassian pressure and questions of artificial life drive the Enterprise through a season of divided loyalties, temporal anomalies and increasingly intimate consequences for command.

s06e01.description: Picard follows Data into 1890s San Francisco as the crew works with Guinan and Mark Twain to stop temporal predators.

s06e02.description: Barclay’s transporter phobia seems irrational until he begins seeing figures inside the matter stream that may represent trapped survivors.

s06e03.description: An ambassador transfers destructive emotions into Troi to preserve his own stability, rapidly aging and destabilizing her.

s06e04.description: The Enterprise rescues Scotty from a transporter buffer inside a Dyson sphere, where the retired engineer struggles with being obsolete.

s06e05.description: Crew members discover they are being abducted from the Enterprise at night and subjected to experiments by beings from another dimension.

s06e06.description: A young intern aboard the Enterprise discovers she has Q-like powers, forcing her to choose between human life and the Continuum.

s06e07.description: A transporter accident turns Picard, Ro, Keiko and Guinan into children just as Ferengi raiders seize the Enterprise.

s06e08.description: A holodeck Western becomes dangerous when its characters acquire Data’s appearance and abilities while Worf and Alexander are trapped inside.

s06e09.description: Data concludes that experimental maintenance machines may be sentient and risks a rescue mission to protect their right to exist.

s06e10.description: Picard leaves the Enterprise for a secret mission against Cardassia while a severe new captain takes command of the ship.

s06e11.description: Picard endures Gul Madred’s interrogation and psychological torture as Jellico prepares the Enterprise for a Cardassian confrontation.

s06e12.description: Moriarty returns from holodeck storage and constructs an elaborate reality to force the crew to address his demand for freedom.

s06e13.description: Geordi investigates the apparent murder of a Starfleet communications officer and becomes drawn to the missing woman as evidence grows stranger.

s06e14.description: Troi awakens surgically altered as a Romulan officer and is forced into a covert mission to smuggle dissidents across the Neutral Zone.

s06e15.description: After Picard dies in surgery, Q offers him the chance to alter the reckless mistake of his youth that shaped his entire adult life.

s06e16.description: Worf learns that Klingons captured at Khitomer may still be alive while Data experiences dreamlike visions after an electrical accident.

s06e17.description: Worf finds the hidden Klingon survivors and tries to restore their children’s suppressed heritage despite the colony’s desire for peace.

s06e18.description: Picard is trapped aboard the evacuated Enterprise with thieves stealing dangerous engine by-products during a scheduled maintenance sweep.

s06e19.description: Picard begins a relationship with the ship’s new stellar cartographer, then must send her on a mission where her specialist skills are essential.

s06e20.description: Picard follows his mentor’s archaeological clues into a race with Klingons, Cardassians and Romulans to uncover an ancient genetic message.

s06e21.description: Riker rehearses a play about insanity, then finds himself apparently confined in an alien psychiatric hospital where reality keeps shifting.

s06e22.description: Crusher risks her career investigating the apparent murder of a Ferengi scientist whose new shielding technology may actually work.

s06e23.description: A clone of Kahless appears at a Klingon monastery, forcing Worf to reconcile religious faith with political manipulation.

s06e24.description: A transporter duplicate of Riker is discovered after years alone, reopening old ambitions and his unfinished relationship with Troi.

s06e25.description: Picard, Data, Troi and La Forge return to find the Enterprise and a Romulan ship frozen at the instant of catastrophic destruction.

s06e26.description: Data experiences anger while fighting unusually individual Borg led by Lore, and Picard follows the threat into dangerous territory.
